headline: IASLC: Lung Cancer Considered episode shares expert perspectives from ESMO26
dek: The International Association for the Study of Lung Cancer said its latest Lung Cancer Considered episode brings together guests to discuss perspectives from the ESMO26 meeting.
body:
The International Association for the Study of Lung Cancer (IASLC) said on X that the latest episode of Lung Cancer Considered features expert perspectives from ESMO26. The post described the episode as bringing together voices from the thoracic oncology field.

According to the post, the episode is hosted by Drs. @StephenVLiu and @NarjustFlorezMD. They welcome three guests, identified by their X handles as @DrJNaidoo, @sands_jacob and @FSkoulidis. IASLC said the guests "share insights from across the thoracic oncology community."

The post included a link for listening to the episode and used the hashtags #LungCancer and #ThoracicOncology. It did not state which topics, studies or findings are discussed, so the content of the conversation is not detailed in the announcement itself.
key_quote: share insights from across the thoracic oncology community
